posts.text: Beyond the SAVE Act… Congress has not codified border security, has not passed anything defining birthright citizenship, has not materially protected citizens from surveillance, has not passed a ban on congressional stock trading…   And more… So, maybe we should get busy.

posts.text:
The Democratic nominee vetting process seems a lot like their vetting process for gangs and terrorists crossing the border…nonexistent.

It’s never been about standards… it’s all about power and control.
